semantic.justification: Original consumed C API header binding reexports the single actual owner/member implementation. The source parameter contract remains explicit through a typed host binding for default fixed0-or1/null-external-level paragraph calls. There is no second state owner, API fallback or runtime rejection for unported modes; unconsumed mode setters are not exposed. Only default reordering, fixed initial paragraph level0/1, null external levels and paragraph owners are admitted. Other ICU modes, external levels, contexts, line construction, allocator exhaustion/native allocation/ABI, invalid pointers and concurrent buffer mutation are not certified. Actual EditEngine constructor/process services and ScFieldEditEngine/DocImport CSV admission remain pending; no complete engine or CSV readiness is claimed.
